G3501.def: including the comparative neoteros neh-o'-ter-os; a primary word; "new", i.e. (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate:--new, young.

G3504.def: from «3501» and a derivative of «5453»; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte"):--novice.

G3505.pos:
Nero = "brave"
  1. a famous but cruel emperor or Rome from 54 to 68 A.D.
G3505.def: of Latin origin; Neron (i.e. Nero), a Roman emperor:--Nero.

G3506.def: apparently a primary verb; to "nod", i.e. (by analogy), signal:--beckon.

G3507.def: from «3509»; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud:--cloud.

G3508.def: of Hebrew origin («05321»); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine:--Nephthalim.

G3509.def: apparently a primary word; a cloud:--cloud.

G3510.def: of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind:--reins.

G3511.et: from a form of (3485) and koreo (to sweep)
G3511.def: from a form of «3485» and koreo (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary:--worshipper.

G3512.def: from the comparative of «3501»; appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile:--youthful.

G3513.pos:
1. by
    1. used in the affirmations of oaths
G3513.def: probably an intensive form of «3483»; a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as:--I protest by.

G3514.def: from neo (of like meaning); to spin:--spin.

G3515.def: from «3516»; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently:--be a child.

G3516.et: from an obsolete particle ne- (implying negation) and (2031)
G3516.def: from an obsolete particle ne- (implying negation) and «2031»; not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian:--babe, child (+ -ish).

G3517.et: apparently from a derivative of the base of (3491) (meaning wet)
G3517.def: apparently from a derivative of the base of «3491» (meaning wet); Nereus, a Christian:--Nereus.

G3518.def: of Hebrew origin («05374»); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite:--Neri.

G3520.def: probably from the base of «3491»; an island:--island, isle.

G3521.def: from «3522»; abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement:-- fast(-ing).

G3523.et: from the insep. negative particle ne- (not) and (2068)
G3523.def: from the inseparable negative particle ne- (not) and «2068»; not eating, i.e. abstinent from food (religiously):--fasting.

G3525.def: of uncertain affinity: to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet:--be sober, watch.

G3526.def: of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian:--Niger.

G3527.def: probably from «3528»; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian:--Nicanor.

G3528.def: from «3529»; to subdue (literally or figuratively):--conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory.

G3529.def: apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success:--victory.

G3530.def: from «3534» and «1218»; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an Israelite:--Nicodemus.

G3531.def: from «3532»; a Nicolaite, i.e. adherent of Nicolaus:--Nicolaitane.

G3532.def: from «3534» and «2994»; victorious over the people; Nicolaus, a heretic:--Nicolaus.

G3533.def: from «3534» and «4172»; victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in Macedonia:--Nicopolis.

G3534.def: from «3529»; a conquest (concretely), i.e. (by implication) triumph:--victory.

G3535.def: of Hebrew origin («05210»); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of Assyria:--Nineve.

G3536.def: from «3535»; a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh:--of Nineve, Ninevite.

G3538.et: to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face)
G3538.def: to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face); ceremonially, to perform ablution:--wash. Compare «3068».

G3539.def: from «3563»; to exercise the mind (observe), i.e. (figuratively) to comprehend, heed:--consider, perceive, think, understand.

G3540.def: from «3539»; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself:--device, mind, thought.

G3541.def: of uncertain affinity; a spurious or illegitimate son:--bastard.

G3542.def: feminine from the same as «3551»; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage:--X eat, pasture.

G3543.def: from «3551»; properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard:-- suppose, thing, be wont.

G3544.def: from «3551»; according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law:--about the law, lawyer.

G3545.def: adverb from a derivative of «3551»; legitimately (specially, agreeably to the rules of the lists):--lawfully.

G3546.def: from «3543»; what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma), i.e. current coin:--money.

G3547.def: from «3551» and «1320»; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a Rabbi:--doctor (teacher) of the law.

G3548.def: from «3550»; legislation (specially, the institution of the Mosaic code):--giving of the law.

G3549.def: from «3550»; to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them):--establish, receive the law.

G3550.def: from «3551» and a derivative of «5087»; a legislator:--lawgiver.

G3551.et: from a primary nemo (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals)
G3551.def: from a primary nemo (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals); law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle):--law.

G3552.def: from «3554»; to be sick, i.e. (by implication, of a diseased appetite) to hanker after (figuratively, to harp upon):--dote.

G3554.def: of uncertain affinity; a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral disability):--disease, infirmity, sickness.

G3557.et: middle voice from nosphi (apart or clandestinely)
G3557.def: middle voice from nosphi (apart or clandestinely); to sequestrate for oneself, i.e. embezzle:--keep back, purloin.

G3558.def: of uncertain affinity; the south(-west) wind; by extension, the southern quarter itself:--south (wind).

G3559.def: from «3563» and a derivative of «5087»; calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning:--admonition.

G3560.def: from the same as «3559»; to put in mind, i.e. (by implication) to caution or reprove gently:--admonish, warn.

G3561.et: from of a compound of (3501) and (3376) (as noun by implication of (2250))
G3561.def: feminine of a compound of «3501» and «3376» (as noun by implication, of «2250»); the festival of new moon:--new moon.

G3562.et: from a comparative of the accusative case of (3563) and (2192)
G3562.def: adverb from a comparative of the accusative case of «3563» and «2192»; in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently:--discreetly.

G3563.def: probably from the base of «1097»; the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning:--mind, understanding. Compare «5590».

G3564.et: probably contracted for a compound of (3565) and (1435)
G3564.def: probably contracted for a compound of «3565» and «1435»; nymph-given (i.e. -born); Nymphas, a Christian:--Nymphas.

G3565.et: from a primary but obsolete verb nupto (to veil as a bride, cf Latin "nupto," to marry)
G3565.def: from a primary but obsolete verb nupto (to veil as a bride; compare Latin "nupto," to marry); a young married woman (as veiled), including a betrothed girl; by implication, a son's wife:--bride, daughter in law.

G3568.et: a primary particle of present time
G3568.def: a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate:--henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time). See also «3569», «3570».

G3569.def: from neuter plural of «3588» and «3568»; the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present:--(but) now.

G3570.et: a prolonged form of (3568) for emphasis
G3570.def: a prolonged form of «3568» for emphasis; just now:--now.

G3572.def: apparently a primary word; to prick ("nudge"):--pierce.

G3573.def: from a presumed derivative of «3506»; to nod, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep; figuratively, to delay:--slumber.

G3574.def: from «3571» and «2250»; a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four hours:--night and day.

G3575.def: of Hebrew origin («05146»); Noe, (i.e. Noach), a patriarch:--Noe.

G3576.def: from a derivative of «3541»; sluggish, i.e. (literally) lazy, or (figuratively) stupid:--dull, slothful.

G3578.def: from «3581»; hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of entertainment:--lodging.

G3579.def: from «3581»; to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be (make, appear) strange:--entertain, lodge, (think it) strange.

G3580.def: from a compound of «3581» and «1209»; to be hospitable:--lodge strangers.

G3581.def: apparently a primary word; foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively, novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer:--host, strange(-r).

G3582.et: as if from xeo (properly, to smooth, by implication [of friction] to boil or heat)
G3582.def: as if from xeo (properly, to smooth; by implication, (of friction) to boil or heat); a vessel (as fashioned or for cooking) (or perhaps by corruption from the Latin sextarius, the sixth of a modius, i.e. about a pint), i.e. (specially), a measure for liquids or solids, (by analogy, a pitcher):--pot.

G3583.def: from «3584»; to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature:--dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away).

G3584.et: from the base of (3582) (through the idea of scorching)
G3584.def: from the base of «3582» (through the idea of scorching); arid; by implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water):--dry land, withered.

G3586.et: from another form of the base of (3582)
G3586.def: from another form of the base of «3582»; timber (as fuel or material); by implication, a stick, club or tree or other wooden article or substance:--staff, stocks, tree, wood.

G3587.et: from a derivative of the same as (3586) (meaning a razor)
G3587.def: from a derivative of the same as «3586» (meaning a razor); to shave or "shear" the hair:--shave.

G3588.et: in all their inflections, the definite article
G3588.def: in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom):--the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.

G3591.def: probably from the same as «43»; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance):--weight.

G3592.pos: 1. this one here, these things, as follows, thus
G3592.def: from «3588» and «1161»; the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun:--he, she, such, these, thus.

G3594.def: from «3595»; to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)):--guide, lead.

G3595.def: from «3598» and «2233»; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)):--guide, leader.

G3596.def: from a compound of «3598» and «4198»; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel:--go on a journey.

G3598.def: apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means:--journey, (high-)way.

G3599.def: perhaps from the base of «2068»; a "tooth":--tooth.
